response:
I have resolved the issue where `Prefetch()` objects failed when given a sliced queryset.

### Summary of Changes
1. **[`django/db/models/fields/related_descriptors.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-co40d9dm/django/db/models/fields/related_descriptors.py)**:
   - Added [`_filter_prefetch_queryset()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-co40d9dm/django/db/models/fields/related_descriptors.py#L92-L127) to handle filtering prefetched querysets that have been sliced by clearing the slice limits and filtering over a `Window(RowNumber())` partitioned by the relation and ordered by the queryset's ordering (raising `NotSupportedError` on backends without window function support).
   - Updated [`ReverseManyToOneDescriptor`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-co40d9dm/django/db/models/fields/related_descriptors.py#L774-L793) (`RelatedManager`) and [`ManyToManyDescriptor`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-co40d9dm/django/db/models/fields/related_descriptors.py#L1119-L1168) (`ManyRelatedManager`) to use `_filter_prefetch_queryset()` in `get_prefetch_queryset()` and preserve slice limits in `_apply_rel_filters()`.
   - Updated [`ForwardManyToOneDescriptor.get_prefetch_queryset()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-co40d9dm/django/db/models/fields/related_descriptors.py#L168-L212) and [`ReverseOneToOneDescriptor.get_prefetch_queryset()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-co40d9dm/django/db/models/fields/related_descriptors.py#L444-L472) to handle sliced querysets.
2. **[`django/contrib/contenttypes/fields.py`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-co40d9dm/django/contrib/contenttypes/fields.py)**:
   - Updated `GenericRelatedObjectManager` ([`_apply_rel_filters()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-co40d9dm/django/contrib/contenttypes/fields.py#L604-L619) and [`get_prefetch_queryset()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-co40d9dm/django/contrib/contenttypes/fields.py#L634-L672)) to support sliced querysets using `_filter_prefetch_queryset()`.
